## Validation

<!-- List the commands you ran and the result. -->

- [ ] Tests added or updated using red-green-refactor where behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] `npm run plugin:validate` (when plugin packaging changes)
- [ ] `npm run fixtures:validate` (when rendering behavior changes)

## Review notes

- [ ] No secrets, private URLs, recordings, cookies, or user data are included
- [ ] Public-facing claims match verified behavior
- [ ] Documentation and fixtures are updated if the user-visible contract changed
